title: Theia application package.json properties
description: Schema for the 'theia', 'theiaPlugins', 'theiaPluginsDir', and 'theiaPluginsExcludeIds' fields used to configure a Theia-based application. Generated from dev-packages/application-package/src/application-props.ts (eclipse-theia/theia, master branch).

theia.description: Base configuration for the Theia application.

target.description: Whether the extension/application targets the browser or electron.

next.description: If true, Theia will prefer 'next' over 'latest' as the npm dist-tag when resolving dependencies.

frontend.description: Frontend related properties. These are injected into index.html.

theiaPluginsDir.description: Location (relative to package.json) to store downloaded VS Code/Open VSX plugins.

theiaPlugins.description: Map of plugin id to download URL (typically an Open VSX .vsix URL). Resolved by 'theia download:plugins'.

theiaPluginsExcludeIds.description: Plugin ids to exclude from deployment, e.g. when pulled in transitively via an extension pack but known to misbehave.

defaultTheme.description: The default color theme for the application. Either a single theme id, or a light/dark pair.

defaultIconTheme.description: The default file icon theme id for the application.

defaultLocale.description: The default locale for the application.

validatePreferencesSchema.description: When true, validates the JSON schema of preferences on start and logs warnings if invalid.

reloadOnReconnect.description: When true, the window will reload if the frontend reconnects to a backend that no longer has a connection context for it.

windowOptions.description: Overrides/additions to Electron's BrowserWindow constructor options (e.g. width, height, frame, titleBarStyle).

showWindowEarly.description: Whether to show an empty Electron window as early as possible.

splashScreenOptions.description: Configuration for a splash screen shown while the app loads. Defaults to {} which means no splash screen.

width.description: Initial width of the splash screen.

height.description: Initial height of the splash screen.

minDuration.description: Minimum time in ms to show the splash screen before the main window is shown.

maxDuration.description: Maximum time in ms before the splash screen is removed and the main window is shown regardless.

content.description: Path (resolved from application root) to the content to load in the splash screen. Mandatory if you want a splash screen at all.

appUserModelId.description: Id for the Jump List in the Windows taskbar. MUST match the 'appId' field in your electron-builder config.

uriScheme.description: The custom URI scheme the application registers with the OS.

singleInstance.description: If true and running in Electron mode, only one instance of the application is allowed to run at a time.

frontendConnectionTimeout.description: Time in ms the connection context is preserved for reconnection after a frontend disconnects.

configurationFolder.description: Configuration folder name within the user's home folder.

configureProxyFromPreferences.description: When true, proxy-related preferences (http.proxy, http.proxyStrictSSL, http.proxyAuthorization) are read from the backend PreferenceService and applied. When false, proxy config only comes from CLI flags or HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY env vars. Enable for trusted desktop/Electron deployments; leave disabled for cloud deployments.

preloadTemplate.description: File path or raw HTML template used for extra preload content markup.
